note: Wooded family campground near Big Manitou Falls, Wisconsin's highest waterfall, with a swim beach on Interfalls Lake in the day-use area. The three backpack sites are a 1.6-mile hike from the parking area. No generators in the campground. --Claude
summary: DNR camping page + campground map read: 59 family sites (18 electric), mostly pull-through, no water/sewer hookups, dump, summer showers/flush toilets, vault toilets, water.
